summary: Long-stay test 4 leads: fails on any count available. $50 confirmed, right at the gate. Sites 25->300, weekend 2-night minimum, phone booking, opens May 1, military cleared. Lakeview in doubt.
flags: LONG-STAY DROP CANDIDATE, for AWH: test 4 fails on any count I can find. The stored ~25 (unsourced) would be 8% of 300, and the map's 12 'A' full-hookup sites 4%, against the 1-in-10 bar. Caveat: no page states a nightly count, and the map's legend says all sites are water and electric, but the rates page prices only pull-through full hookups. A call would settle it.

Other tests: (1) $50 for 2 people (2026), exactly at the line, no gateway (Cleveland 71 km). (2) passes: nightly rate on its own site + phone. (3) passes: 2-night minimum is Fri-Sun only. (5) lead: 'perfect place to settle for a season' and it sells RVs 'already set up right here on our campground'. Reviews seen in search mention mostly long-term residents.
PRESENCE passes: own site + phone 440-466-2320; Google 4.6 (188). PRICE passes on the posted rate. No booking site: reservations by phone only.
GOOD SAM: stored false, but the old site map carries a Good Sampark logo. Current pages don't claim it, so stored false is left.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (down): stored 'lakeview', with evidence of rows by ponds 15-25 m. On the map the 12 full-hookup 'A' sites are by the office, not on a lake (Lodge Lake is further south). Imagery shows trailer rows by the ponds, and those look seasonal. If nightly guests only get the 'A' rows, lakeview doesn't describe their stay.
PIN OK: on the campground beside a pond, among the rows; no site list to compute a centroid.
